uncited: NeRV Evaluation Variants are inference-time strategies for the NeRV (Neural Reflectance and Visibility Fields) representation that trade rendering speed for shadow fidelity or material generality.
They address the limitation of the base NeRV method, which uses a learned visibility MLP for efficiency but produces soft shadows and assumes diffuse surfaces.
The variants allow users to choose between sharp shadows via brute-force tracing or extended material support via deferred queries, while reusing the same trained model.
The NeRV model consists of a neural network that outputs reflectance and visibility properties for any 3D point.
The evaluation variants modify the rendering loop (ray marching) at test time.
